title: Connect Claude asks Anthropic for the loopback redirect http://localhost:53692/callback (not the old console.anthropic.com code-paste address Anthropic refuses with "Invalid request format"), catches the callback itself and exchanges the code with that same redirect
steps: S1: in vendor/tracy/dsh-subscriptions, node --import ./test/_setup.mjs --test test/claude-oauth-loopback.test.mjs (the whole plugin through apply() with default config: the real /oauth/start, the real loopback on :53692 hit with code+state, the token request body captured by a stand-in fetch).

S2: the running Tracy Cowork app (local mode, --remote-debugging-port, TRACY_APP_CDP, default http://127.0.0.1:9334): from its dsh page GET /dsh-subscriptions/oauth/start?provider=claude&index=1; then read whether something listens on TCP 53692. Never open the returned URL.
expect: S1: clean TAP; the named test passes.

S2: 200; redirectUri = http://localhost:53692/callback; autoCatch = true; the URL is https://claude.ai/oauth/authorize with redirect_uri = that loopback, code = true, client_id 9d1c250a-e61b-44d9-88ed-5944d1962f5e, code_challenge_method S256; TCP 53692 listens.
fence: The redirect the plugin asks Anthropic for and the loopback that catches it. Not covered: Anthropic accepting it and a real sign-in (by hand: Settings › Model plan › Connect on Claude).
